//: Type-checking only — no emit, no build step. Existing server code in
src/ ships as plain JavaScript (typechecked via checkJs over JSDoc).
New code is TypeScript (.ts) in scripts/ and cli/, run directly via tsx
(`npm run validate` / the `ssh-manager` CLI) without emitting files.
tsc here is purely a static checker (`npm run typecheck`); tsx handles
execution. Strictness is deliberately moderate: the goal is catching the
mistakes that actually bit this project (reading a config field that does
not exist — see issue #49 — wrong argument counts, typos on typed objects).
